lesson: The system is consistently attempting to fade high-velocity momentum moves and trend continuations, resulting in premature entries against strong directional bias. By ignoring the Wyckoff distribution phase and attempting to catch reversals during high-volume spikes, the strategy is being trapped in liquidity sweeps.
adjustment: Implement a mandatory 'Trend Alignment Filter' that prohibits counter-trend entries unless a confirmed Wyckoff Spring or Upthrust is identified on the 4H timeframe.
methodology_flag: Trust RSI/Bollinger Band overbought/oversold signals LESS during high-velocity momentum phases.
